title: [Extensibility Request] issue 30334: fix OnAfterCarryOutToReqWksh record order
summary: The OnAfterCarryOutToReqWksh integration event now passes the target requisition line as a modifiable var parameter, allowing subscribers to persist changes to the newly created line.
key_points: Target requisition line is now the first var parameter of OnAfterCarryOutToReqWksh
Subscribers can now modify and persist changes to the target line
Restores the parameter order from before version 28.1
Fixes a regression that removed extensibility for target line modifications
Change applied to both W1 and NA layers
